metadata.name: Glimm Transition
metadata.description: WebGL sweep transitions for React. A colour band sweeps across the viewport, revealing the incoming view behind it while retaining the outgoing view ahead. Wrap your app in GlimmProvider and call sweep(navigate) from useGlimm() on any route or state change. Zero runtime dependencies, respects prefers-reduced-motion, falls back gracefully without WebGL. By Noman Ijaz, MIT.
metadata.author: nomanjack
